verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Discord serves an llms.txt documentation index at docs.discord.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its docs pages are available as markdown (.md) and explicitly tell readers to fetch the complete index from llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed directly at them. Many .md doc URLs in the pack corroborate machine-readable docs coverage. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, and independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
